title: A tarot deck of machining sins: chatter, crashed tool, forgotten work offset
summary: An original machining tarot: seven fictional cards, seven practical recoveries.

blocks.heading: The deck knows what you forgot to check
blocks.body: An invented shop-floor tarot. Advance one card at a time. The predictions are jokes; the checks are ordinary machining discipline.

slides.title: I · The Forgotten Offset
slides.body: A beautiful toolpath enters the wrong coordinate system. Omen: your confidence is higher than your clearance. Recovery: verify the active work coordinate, tool offsets and stock location using the machine’s approved prove-out procedure.

slides.title: II · The Chattering Tower
slides.body: The walls vibrate, and the finish records your ambition. Omen: a long stickout pretending to be a short one. Recovery: stop and inspect rigidity, tool condition, workholding and cutting conditions before making another cut.

slides.title: III · The Reversed Jaw
slides.body: The part departs on a journey nobody funded. Omen: an awkward grip called “probably fine.” Recovery: review clamping engagement, clearance and workholding limits before rotation.

slides.title: IV · The Dull Magician
slides.body: He turns horsepower into heat and calls it productivity. Omen: a size trend wandering while the tool still looks mostly present. Recovery: inspect wear, confirm dimensions and change or index the tool under the approved procedure.

slides.title: V · The Unmeasured First Piece
slides.body: A hundred parts await the good news that the first one was wrong. Omen: production before proof. Recovery: identify required first-article checks, verify the result and release the batch deliberately.

slides.title: VI · The Borrowed Program
slides.body: It ran perfectly somewhere else. Omen: an old setup wearing a new filename. Recovery: verify revision, units, tooling, stock and machine compatibility before prove-out.

slides.title: VII · The Patient Machinist
slides.body: A rare card. The spindle is stopped and a question is being asked. Omen: preventable trouble is about to remain hypothetical. Recovery: keep doing exactly that.

blocks.heading: Read the spread
blocks.body: Most disasters in this deck begin when an assumption is allowed to dress up as a checked fact.
